substantive_commits.summary: Correct the vegetation formal-build contract to the authoritative four maintained paved pits plus two grass-ground trees and dimensioned root-zone construction.
Expand the formal foliage evidence contract so ecology, root-zone grounding, construction metadata and weathering causality are explicit reflection/still/temporal evidence dependencies.
Enforce the expanded vegetation evidence contract in C#, including cross-contract dimensions/counts, direct formal-build source tokens and direct read-only ecology/root-zone validation.

problem_found: The previous formal-build integration contract recorded five paved tree contexts and one grass context, but the authoritative ecology contract, root-zone contract and scene validator all require four maintained paved pits and two grass-ground trees. In addition, the central foliage formal-evidence binding only locked leaf morphology/lamina/silhouette/optics; ecology and root-zone validation were transitive through QualityBlockFoliageOpticsUpgrade and therefore vulnerable to a future refactor silently dropping them from reflection/still evidence.
changes: vegetation_formal_build_integration_contract.json is schema 1.1 and now mirrors the authoritative four-pit/two-grass scene construction rather than the stale five/one assumption.
foliage_formal_evidence_binding_contract.json is schema 1.1 and explicitly includes ecology, root-zone and formal-build integration contracts as upstream dependencies.

Formal foliage evidence now maps zero-auto-point readiness impact to Geometry/Construction, Weathering/Causality, Vegetation/Natural Complexity, Lighting/Reflections and Temporal/LOD while preserving render-only scoring.
QualityBlockFoliageFormalEvidenceBindingQA directly validates ecology/root-zone contracts and formal-build integration counts/dimensions at the same entrypoint used by reflection evidence.

The formal evidence validator checks that QualityBlockFoliageOpticsUpgrade still contains the required ecology contract validation, ecology construction, root-zone construction and both scene validators, preventing a later transitive-validation regression.

During formal evidence-state validation, ecology and root-zone scene validation are called directly and read-only in addition to foliage-optics validation, so reflection polling cannot silently accept a grounded-vegetation regression.
Critical-risk mapping now explicitly includes hero geometry intersection and missing construction/material metadata in addition to repetition, material physics, shimmer and LOD pop.

implementation_readiness.reason: The evidence path is stricter and an incorrect machine-readable construction assumption was corrected, but the remaining seven readiness points are still reserved for actual Unity compile/runtime and formal evidence-path execution.
